text:
jamie: quick heads-up — CI started failing on Next edge builds after the SDK ESM entry change. Failing where the auth header is dropped in runtime only when running as edge function :thinking:

nate: saw that on staging earlier today. error is `MissingAuth` from our private proxy — only reproducible in ESM+edge bundle, CJS serverless is fine. :eyes:

sophia: suspect the bundler is tree-shaking `process.env` or our `fetch` wrapper. in edge runtimes globalThis.fetch is different; some bundlers replace `process.env` at build time -> headers lost if code path optimized out.

maria: can you paste the minimal repro? I tried locally and couldn't repro with next dev, only in vercel preview.

jamie: repro steps I used (fails on Vercel/Edge):
```bash
# run with next edge target
git checkout pr/234 && npm i && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build && vercel dev --edge
# then call /api/infer with an Authorization header
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" http://localhost:3000/api/infer
```
response shows 401 from proxy.

nate: fwiw, adding a trivial `console.log(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)` in the SDK made it work — confirms tree-shake/polyfill issue.

sophia: workaround that worked for me in Next: add `transpilePackages: ['@redwood/inference']` (next.config.js with experimental/tranpilePackages) OR `webpack`/turbo config to avoid ESM build optimization. for Vite, set `ssr.noExternal: ['@redwood/inference']`. Also ensure the package.json exports include an ESM browser entry.

maria: example next.config tweak I used:
```js
// next.config.js
module.exports = {
  experimental: { transpilePackages: ['@redwood/inference'] },
  webpack: (cfg) => {
    cfg.externals = cfg.externals || []
    // keep SDK in build
    return cfg
  }
}
```

jamie: another thing — edge fetch behavior. streaming responses were getting cut off because our helper assumed Node Response semantics. In edge, you need to pipe ReadableStream correctly. Patch in PR adds a safe branch: `if (globalThis.Response && response.body instanceof ReadableStream) { /* stream as web stream */ }`

sophia: PR note about bundlers: add `package.json` exports like:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default": "dist/esm/index.js"
  }
}
```
so bundlers pick correct entry. also add `sideEffects: false` carefully — we might have to mark some files as side-effectful.

nate: for auth setup in edge functions remind folks to use runtime env injection rather than `process.env` at build-time. e.g., on Vercel set environment variables and read them at runtime via `process.env` in server functions (edge supports envs differently). If using a serverless adapter that inlines envs at build, the header string can get baked in or removed.

jamie: I pushed a small debug PR that pins the ESM entry and adds runtime guard for fetch streaming — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/234 — would appreciate reviewers. Also added notes to the devex doc about bundler gotchas.

maria: left two quick comments on the PR: one about adding a test for Vite SSR and one asking for a fallback to fetch polyfill only when needed.

sophia: ok I'll review today. +1 on adding a tiny integration under `examples/next-edge` so we can CI that matrix (next/vite + edge/serverless).

ci-bot: build passed on branch pr/234 (linux, node 20), failing on vercel preview (edge). Logs: `Edge runtime: auth header not forwarded`

jamie: plan: merge the safe guards + docs now, follow-up to add example app and CI matrix. if anyone has quick repros or config snippets add here. thanks! :rocket:
